about: The centre of each UK postcode district, as the mean of every full postcode in it. Used to set where the mat is without needing the internet.
source: Postcode coordinates from the National Statistics Postcode Lookup, via github.com/odileeds/Postcodes2LatLon, under the Open Government Licence.
